# agenco_agent (Resource)

Registers an agent identity and issues credentials for it. The API has no update route, so any change to a managed attribute replaces the agent and rotates its credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agenco_agent" "nightly_reconciler" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  name           = "nightly-reconciler"
  autonomous     = true
  description    = "Reconciles settled orders against the ledger every night"
  owner_email    = "platform@example.com"
  tags           = ["batch", "finance"]
}

output "reconciler_client_id" {
  value = agenco_agent.nightly_reconciler.credentials_id
}

output "reconciler_client_secret" {
  value     = agenco_agent.nightly_reconciler.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application the agent is registered against.
- `name` (String) Agent name, up to 255 characters.

### Optional

- `agent_class` (String) Trust class of the agent. One of: [internal external unknown]. Ignored when autonomous is true.
- `autonomous` (Boolean) Register the agent as autonomous. Autonomous agents take a description instead of an agent class and redirect URLs.
- `description` (String) Description of the agent. Only used when autonomous is true.
- `owner_email` (String) Email of the person responsible for the agent.
- `redirect_urls` (List of String) OAuth redirect URLs. Only used when autonomous is false.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags attached to the agent.

### Read-Only

- `agent_source` (String) How the agent came to be known: registered, auto-detected or discovered.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret issued to the agent. Returned only at registration time.
- `credentials_id` (String) Client ID issued to the agent.
- `id` (String) Agent ID.
- `identity_tier` (String) Identity tier derived from the trust score.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the agent.
- `trust_score` (Number) Current trust score, when one has been computed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The client secret is only returned at registration, so an imported agent has none in state.
terraform import agenco_agent.nightly_reconciler bbbbcccc-dddd-eeee-ffff-000011112222
```
